verdicts.reason: A reverses the reading order by putting the CTA at the far left, before the headline. The shoe, the key product image, shrinks to a tiny smudge in the top-right corner that the LIMITED badge collides with, so the product is effectively lost. B keeps the original left-to-right order of shoe, headline, then action, but the shoe is very small, the subtitle is close to illegible at this size, and the CTA and badge are crammed tightly under the copy with almost no vertical breathing room.
